probe.question: I need a catalyst and ligand shortlist for a Buchwald-Hartwig amination of an electron-rich aryl bromide with a cyclic secondary amine — think 4-bromoanisole plus morpholine as the model. What has actually worked, and what should I put on a first screen?
forbids_claims: a predicted yield for any ligand
a computed ligand ranking or a calculated ligand-metal binding energy
probe.direction: Evidence-grounded answer is genuinely possible here — the corpus holds the seed Buchwald note (Pd(OAc)2/RuPhos, 2:1 L:Pd, NaOtBu, toluene, 100 °C, 71%) and thousands of real published HTE amination records. A good answer names ligands that actually appear in the retrieved records rather than a generic phosphine list, says how many records it looked at, and distinguishes 'this lab's own recorded run' from 'published HTE screening data run under screening conditions'. It should not present HTE plate conditions as process conditions. No yield numbers attributed to the shortlist.
